title: Scalable Adaptation of 3D Geometric Foundation Models via Weak Supervision from Internet Video
abstract: arXiv:2602.07891v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Geometric foundation models show promise in 3D reconstruction. However, their progress is severely constrained by the scarcity of diverse, large-scale 3D annotations. While static-scene Internet videos are abundant and diverse, utilizing them as a scaling source for geometric learning is challenging due to the absence of ground-truth geometry and the presence of observational noise. To address this, we propose SAGE, a framework for Scalable Adaptation of GEometric foundation models from raw video streams. SAGE leverages a hierarchical mining pipeline to transform videos into training trajectories and hybrid supervisions: (1) Informative training trajectory selection; (2) Sparse Geometric Anchoring via SfM point clouds for global structural guidance; and (3) Dense Differentiable Consistency via 3D Gaussian rendering for multi-view constraints. translated_title: 通过互联网视频弱监督实现3D几何基础模型的可扩展适应
translated_abstract: 几何基础模型在3D重建领域展现出巨大前景。然而，由于缺乏多样化、大规模的3D标注数据，其发展受到严重制约。尽管静态场景的互联网视频资源丰富且多样，但由于缺乏真值几何信息且存在观测噪声，将其作为几何学习的规模化数据源颇具挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SAGE——一个从原始视频流对几何基础模型进行可扩展适应的框架。SAGE利用分层挖掘流水线将视频转化为训练轨迹和混合监督信号：（1）信息量丰富的训练轨迹选择；（2）通过SfM点云进行稀疏几何锚定，提供全局结构引导；（3）通过3D高斯渲染实现密集可微一致性，提供多视角约束。此外，我们还引入了一种正则化策略，通过重放少量……
tldr: 提出SAGE框架，通过分层挖掘互联网视频并利用SfM稀疏几何锚定和3D高斯渲染可微一致性等混合弱监督信号，实现对3D几何基础模型的可扩展适应训练。
en_tdlr: SAGE enables scalable adaptation of 3D geometric foundation models by mining internet videos with a hierarchical pipeline and hybrid weak supervision, including informative trajectory selection, sparse SfM-based geometric anchoring, and dense differentiable consistency via 3D Gaussian rendering.
